This policy explains what data we collect when you use this website, why, and how to exercise your rights.

Data controller

MABEL AGENCY, 25 rue Jules Isaac, 13009 Marseille, France. Contact: contact@accessibilitenumerique.eu.

Data collected

When you use the contact form, we collect: your full name, your organisation, your work email address, your phone number if you provide it, your country, your type of organisation and the content of your message.

We do not collect any sensitive data and do not ask for any information about your health or disability.

Purposes and legal basis

Your data is used only to answer your request and, where relevant, to send you a commercial proposal. This processing is based on your consent and on pre-contractual steps taken at your request.

Retention period

Your data is kept for [3 years] from our last exchange, then deleted.

Recipients

Your data is accessible only to the people at the firm who handle your request, and to our hosting provider, Cloudflare.

Where data is transferred outside the European Union, these transfers are covered by appropriate safeguards (European Commission standard contractual clauses).

Cookies

This website does not use advertising cookies. [Specify any audience measurement tools used.]

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data. To exercise these rights, write to contact@accessibilitenumerique.eu.

You may also lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority: the CNIL in France, the Data Protection Authority in Belgium, the CNPD in Luxembourg or the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner in Switzerland.
